title: Dakota Express
desc: Owners of a bus, Krishna and Sundar, face numerous problems due to poor conditions. However, their life takes a turn when the daughter of the minister takes refuge in their bus.

title: DD Returns
desc: An event manager and his friends hide the money they stole in a haunted bungalow to evade the police but when they go back to retrieve it, the ghosts force them to play a dangerous game.

title: Johnny Johnny Yes Papa
desc: Johnny, along with his father, works for social causes under the pretext of a software management firm. His life, however, takes a huge turn when he meets Priya and falls for her.

title: Kousalya Supraja Rama
desc: Inspired by his father's values, Ram grows up to become a chauvinist with a rigid view of masculinity. However, a woman named Shivani begins to transform him into a better man.

title: O Premave
desc: Raja, a young man, crosses paths with Prema and falls in love with her. However, their union is opposed by her father, who wishes her to get married to a man of his choice.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Olavina Aasare
desc: Jayant, a criminal, is hired by a crime boss to marry a wealthy estate owner's daughter, Rajini, and take over her property. However, in a twist of fate, things go awry.

title: Naanu Matthu Gunda 2
desc: A devoted dog does not move from his owner's grave, maintaining a constant watch. Years later, a young boy develops a unique bond with the loyal dog, resulting in an incredible companionship.
